primitives.name: Main Slate Partitioning Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Critical slate-format finding The sites covering this exact slate (RotoBaller, FantasyLabs, FantasyPros, Fox Sports) define the FanDuel "main slate" as **12 Sunday games** — they explicitly exclude the Sunday-night (Cowboys @ Giants) and Monday-night (Broncos @ Chiefs) games.

primitives.assumptions: All major DFS sites agree on 12-game Sunday slate definition; prime-time games are deterministically excluded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Exclusion of {Cowboys @ Giants, Broncos @ Chiefs} from total Sunday slate.

layer2.mapping: Maps to GSI probabilistic event space where each game is a Bernoulli trial for inclusion in main slate.
layer2.telemetry: Consensus agreement across RotoBaller, FantasyLabs, FantasyPros, Fox Sports.

primitives.assumptions: Each salary is confirmed by at least one independent source; multi-source confirmation increases reliability.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Verification threshold n_s ≥ 1 for inclusion in dataset.
